---
description: 'A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design. Stateless — writes nothing to the repo. Use when there is no working directory under the idea.'
argument-hint: 'What should I grill you about?'
---

Run the `grilling` skill on whatever the user brought.

Stateless: do not create or edit `CONTEXT.md`, ADRs, or any other file. If a working directory is present and the user would benefit from a paper trail, say so once and offer `/grill-with-docs` — then carry on either way.
